name: Settings
open.detail: Manage plugins: aliases, startup, state and which ones are enabled
window.title: MyTools Settings
plugins.hint: Type an alias followed by a space to search only that plugin. Separate aliases with spaces or commas. Plugins set to start with MyTools load at startup; on-demand plugins load when first used. Saved changes apply right away.
error.alias: Alias “{alias}” of {name} must be one word of at most 64 bytes.
error.duplicate: Alias “{alias}” is used by both {first} and {second}.
state.idle: Starts on demand; not used yet
state.unknown: State unknown: MyTools is not running
